item.title: Klear 0.2.1
item.description:
• The call toast no longer gets lost when you drag it onto another display, and it comes back to your main screen if its display goes away.
  • "Install Klear driver" now sits at the top of the menu, where you'll see it first.
  • "Hear myself" is now "Test my mic": it records 5 seconds of exactly what your call hears, then plays it back, without the echo that live monitoring caused through speakers.

item.title: Klear 0.2.0
item.description: Klear's first public release: noise removal for every meeting app, on-device call transcription, voice effects, a 14-day free trial, and automatic updates from here on.
